summary: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. filed an 8-K to report entry into a Seventh Supplemental Indenture for $500M of 6.500% notes due 2029. The notes are unsecured, pay semiannual interest, and are redeemable at the company's option (make-whole prior to September 15, 2029, par thereafter). Proceeds will repay existing revolving credit facility and maturing June 2026 notes. This is a routine debt issuance and refinancing, not a special situation. No analyst action is warranted.
